Stateless random bit generator

Source: R/prng.R
lax_rng_bit_generator.Rd

Port of jax.lax.rng_bit_generator: uniformly distributed random bits from the XLA RngBitGenerator operation. The output is not guaranteed to be stable across backends or compiler versions; most users should use the random_* functions.

Usage

lax_rng_bit_generator(
  key,
  shape,
  dtype = "uint32",
  algorithm = lax_RandomAlgorithm[["RNG_DEFAULT"]],
  out_sharding = NULL
)

lax_rng_bit_generator_p

Arguments

key

A uint32[4] (or uint64[2]) key.

shape

Integer vector, the shape of the bits.

dtype

An unsigned integer dtype.

algorithm

One of lax_RandomAlgorithm.

out_sharding

Ignored (one device).

Value

list(new_key, bits).
